remarks: Charming 3 bedrooms, 2 Bathrooms home with solid bones and great potential. Hardwood floors throughout the main level. Features a 2-car garage and off-street driveway parking. Conveniently located minutes from Stew Leonards, major shopping and dining. Home is located on the desirable Wilton-Weston line. Listing agent must be present for all showings. 2 hrs notice.
